day.headline: A Monkey day — Rat and Dragon are in step.

reasons: Monkey's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a pickup waiting at the counter
signs.message: Your name's on a bag at that counter. Go collect it.

reasons: Dragon and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a friend you keep meaning to see
signs.message: Quit scheduling her in your head. Name a night, send it.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a coin landing on its side
signs.message: Neither side won that toss. Means it's yours to call.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a text sent for no reason
signs.message: No occasion, no excuse attached. That's exactly why it lands.

reasons: Rat and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Bad first hour, neutral second. Restart the day at lunch.

reasons: Snake pairs with Monkey — a harmonious day
signs.message: Hem's hanging. Two stitches or the tape, five minutes, fixed.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Decide your leaving time now, then quit relitigating tonight.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Ask the new one an actual question tonight. Not small talk.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the version of you at work
signs.message: The work version of you clocks out early today.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Flat ground today. Nothing bouncy, nothing you have to sprint.

reasons: Tiger opposes Monkey — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Someone kept a small detail about you. Sit with that quietly.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That stack by the door can grow another day.
